childcare.description: Licensed daycare shortlist & applications near Lansdowne & Dupont. Ranked with a weighted fit score — open any card to score it and see the breakdown.
playbook: Pulled from City of Toronto's official centre directory and quality-ratings pages (not a generic list) — real addresses, real ELCAQI quality scores where published, and CWELCC status straight from each centre's city profile page.

Confirmed 2026-07-06 — the family wants care starting AT 12 months, not a flexible/later date. Search was expanded beyond the original ~5km/20min radius to find enough true-infant (0-18mo) options. 8 are now in "Ready to Contact": Ossington Ave North, Kids & Company Bloor Christie, Kids & Company Liberty Village, SimplySmart Bloor, Wee Watch Toronto West (home child care agency), Parkdale ELC (CDI), Annex ELC (CDI), and YMCA Child Development Centre. The 6 centres whose listed programs start at 18 months are kept in "Researching" with a direct question drafted: will they consider early admission at 12 months? Ranked further out = less confirmed on distance/fit, so re-check commute before prioritizing the YMCA and Annex options.

"Hi, we live near Lansdowne & Dupont and are expecting our first baby in March 2027, hoping for care starting around March 2028. Could you tell me: (1) are you CWELCC-enrolled and what are current fees, (2) what age do you accept infants/toddlers from and how long is the current waitlist, (3) do you use OneHSN or a direct process, (4) can we register now during pregnancy, (5) how often should we reconfirm interest?"

"Following up to reconfirm our continued interest for our child (due March 2027), targeting a start around March 2028. Please let us know if anything is needed from us or if our position has changed."

Each card has 6 sub-scores (0-10) weighted into one Fit Score (0-100): Proximity 20%, Cost 20%, Reputation 15%, Licensing/quality record 15%, Waitlist odds & fit 15%, Program/continuity fit 15%. Score what you know now; refine after each call.
Use the CSV Import button to add more centres from a full Toronto Open Data pull once available (see geo_filter_script.py) or from Toronto_Childcare_Tracker.xlsx.
